note: P5 W6.4 adversarial manifest, frozen by W0 [P5-C24]. Freezes (a) the exact section-7 focused test-file set and (b) the twelve section-9 attack ids expanded from design 619's nine checklist entries [P5-C40]. assertP5GateResults.ts is invoked ONCE with all four flags and validates BOTH the vitest gate JSON (--results: no failed/skipped/todo, gateFiles set-equal the results, every attack owned by a passing test titled 'refuses: <id>') AND the per-attack artifact JSON (--attack-root: each id present once, passed:true, nonempty assertion, artifact path; --require-exact forbids a stray or missing artifact). The manifest path is an internal constant in the tool, never a flag [P5-C44]. server/control/deploymentState.test.ts is deliberately absent: with abortReason withdrawn, no P5 task edits deploymentState.ts [P5-C58, P5-C62].

attacks.title: refuses: forged-node
attacks.summary: A caller whose Tailscale-derived node identity is not the pinned VM is refused before any signer call; the receipt records refused and the dashboard code is helper-refused.

attacks.title: refuses: forged-source
attacks.summary: A sourceCommit that is not a strict descendant of the live SHA is refused and no request is sent.

attacks.title: refuses: forged-attestation
attacks.summary: An attestationDigest disagreeing with the archive digest is refused; no partial activation occurs.

attacks.title: refuses: unknown-verb
attacks.summary: A verb outside the movement 235 union fails closed protocol-invalid with no store write and no request sent.

attacks.title: refuses: unknown-field
attacks.summary: An extra request field and an extra receipt key each fail the protocol.schema.json wall closed with no store write.

attacks.title: refuses: repeat-key
attacks.summary: The same idempotency key returns the original receipt and opens no second request.

attacks.title: refuses: cooldown
attacks.summary: A second deploy inside five minutes is refused, the receipt records refused, and no swap begins.

attacks.title: refuses: stale-revision
attacks.summary: A transition pinned to an outdated Deployment revision is 409 revision-changed dashboard-side, with no helper invocation and therefore no wire code.

attacks.title: refuses: active-pty
attacks.summary: A deployment with live PTYs offers only close-ptys-and-continue, and a closeAndWait timeout refuses 409 pty-not-confirmed while leaving the revision untouched.

attacks.title: refuses: failed-swap
attacks.summary: An injected swap failure lands in failed with the error retained and only Acknowledge offered.

attacks.title: refuses: rollback
attacks.summary: A rollback is a deliberate movement section 2.5 transition and is never reachable as an Inbox Abort.

attacks.title: refuses: misleading-symlink
attacks.summary: A current symlink pointing outside /opt/kb-releases is refused by the release reader, which reports unavailable rather than a wrong SHA.
